newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers drop in nearby, corn up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers drop in nearby, corn up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers dropped in the nearby positions on Thursday while corn offers firmed one to three cents a bushel, dealers said.
"It seems like there is good demand in the cash market," one U.S. exporter said, referring to the rise in corn FOB values.
In export news, Taiwan's CK group bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Agrex at a tender, traders said.

Jordan on Thursday bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring for second half October shipment at $178.85 per tonne, traders said. Jordan last Tuesday bought an earlier 50,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for October shipment from Continental Grain at $178.80 per tonne.
